LissajousAnimation
Implementation: [src/engine/animation/motion/LissajousAnimation.ts](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/motion/LissajousAnimation.ts).
Package entry points: `retiam`.

items: LissajousAnimation: Traces a Lissajous curve around the entity's current position. Lissajous curves are parametric curves formed by two perpendicular sinusoidal oscillations with different frequencies, producing figure-eights, knots, and other complex repeating patterns. Common frequency ratio patterns: - `freqX=1, freqY=2` → Figure-eight - `freqX=2, freqY=3` → Trefoil knot - `freqX=3, freqY=4` → Complex knot - Equal frequencies with phase = π/2 → Circle/Ellipse

items: PathFunc: A spatial path function that maps progress `t` ∈ [0, 1] to a position along a curved trajectory between `start` and `end`. This controls *where* the entity travels (the spatial trajectory), while the Rate function controls *how fast* it moves along that path.

MotionPath: Factory class for creating [[PathFunc]] closures that define curved spatial trajectories between a start and end position. All methods return a `PathFunc` that can be passed to `AnimOptions.pathFunc` to override the default straight-line interpolation.

cells: static arc(height: number = 1.0, normal?: Vec3Type): PathFunc

Creates an arc path that bows outward from the straight-line path. The arc peaks at the midpoint (t = 0.5) with zero deviation at endpoints. Param: height How much the arc bows outward. Positive values bow in the default perpendicular direction; negative values bow opposite. Param: normal Optional explicit perpendicular axis for the arc plane. If omitted, automatically computed perpendicular to the travel direction (preferring Z-cross, falling back to Y-cross). [Source line 52](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/motion/MotionPath.ts#L52).
static bezier(control1: Vec3Type, control2?: Vec3Type): PathFunc

Creates a Bézier curve path through world-space control points. - With 1 control point: **quadratic** Bézier (parabolic curve). - With 2 control points: **cubic** Bézier (S-curves, loops, etc.). Control points are in **world space**, not relative to start/end. Param: control1 First control point (world space). Param: control2 Optional second control point for cubic Bézier. [Source line 102](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/motion/MotionPath.ts#L102).
static parabolic(peakHeight: number = 1.0, axis?: Vec3Type): PathFunc

Creates a parabolic (projectile) arc path. The entity follows a straight line from start to end but with an added parabolic bulge in the specified "up" direction, simulating a toss or throw. Param: peakHeight Height of the parabola peak above the straight-line midpoint. Param: axis The "up" direction for the arc. Defaults to Y-up `[0, 1, 0]`. [Source line 157](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/motion/MotionPath.ts#L157).
static wave(amplitude: number = 0.5, waves: number = 2, normal?: Vec3Type): PathFunc

Creates a wave (sinusoidal) path that oscillates perpendicular to the straight-line trajectory between start and end. Param: amplitude Peak deviation from the straight line. Param: waves Number of complete sine wave cycles over the path. Param: normal Optional explicit perpendicular axis for the wave direction. If omitted, automatically computed from the travel direction. [Source line 192](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/motion/MotionPath.ts#L192).
